title: Quentin and the Border
author: Hazel Halloran
blurb: Jonah Dunmore, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
